newsitem.title: USA: HA-LO rises on Champion agreement.
newsitem.headline: HA-LO rises on Champion agreement.

text.p: Shares of HA-LO Industries Inc jumped after the company said it signed an exclusive agreement to distribute branded Champion apparel to the corporate promotional market.
"It's a terrific relationship," said Ellen Baras, an analyst with Nesbitt Burns.

Under the agreement, HA-LO will distribute the athletic apparel of Champion, a division of Sara Lee Corp, with corporate logos. Specific terms of the agreement were not disclosed, but analysts said the fact that the agreement is exclusive is key.
"It's another strong, strategic step for HA-LO," said Michael Moe, an analyst with Montgomery Securities. "Champion is a well known and growing brand."
And analysts said the deal with Champion could lead to other important agreements.
"HA-LO is clearly now capable of doing business with major companies," Baras said.
Shares of HA-LO traded 2-1/4 higher at 28 after reaching a day's high of 29.
